verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills and workflow plugin layered on agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Devin and Hermes. A plugin framework of this kind could plausibly bundle or configure MCP servers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Superpowers adding, configuring or consuming MCP servers or their tools. Its integration points are skills, a session-start bootstrap and harness tool-mapping references, with no MCP mechanism.
